text_markup: For a player to {term:draw} 1 or more cards is to take that many cards from the top of their deck and put them into their hand. {ref:Sec_drawing_cards} provides more details about drawing cards.
text_plain: For a player to draw 1 or more cards is to take that many cards from the top of their deck and put them into their hand. Section 8.4 provides more details about drawing cards.
